correctness.rationale: The free C_q vertex orbits are exactly O_(a,u)={(t,t+a,u)} and have diameter two. Their maximum cross-distance is 2+d_H(u,v) because q>=3 permits a shift avoiding two forbidden residues. Hence the geometric fixed complex is exactly a q-fold clique blow-up, and the projection/section are simplicial contiguous inverses compatible with every scale. Dominated-vertex strong collapses prove the integral natural filtration equivalence; the q=2 boundary, n=2 case and all real scales are handled explicitly. Ten exact finite orbit comparisons and two full mod-two homology computations corroborate the proof, without replacing it.

value.rationale: The theorem identifies an entire family of actual geometric symmetry-fixed Rips filtrations, for all q>=3,n>=2 and all scales, with dimension reduction by two, a shifted parameter and an integral persistence isomorphism. Its sharp q=2 failure and exact first nontrivial barcodes distinguish it from routine static Betti computations, while q-ary higher-scale Rips homology remains accessible through this structural transfer.
